ayahs.ar: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰي قَوْمِهٖٓ اَنْ اَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ ۝١
ayahs.tr: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

ayahs.ar: اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوْهُ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِ ۝٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

ayahs.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّنْ ذُنُوْبِكُمْ وَيُو͏ٔ͏َخِّرْكُمْ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَا࢜ءَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏َخَّرُۘ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ ۝٤
ayahs.tr: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِيْ لَيْلًا وَّنَهَارًا ۝٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَا࢜ءِيْٓ اِلَّا فِرَارًا ۝٦
ayahs.tr: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيْ كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْٓا اَصَابِعَهُمْ فِيْٓ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَاَصَرُّوْا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا ۝٧ۚ
ayahs.tr: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا ۝٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: Then I invited them publicly.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنِّيْٓ اَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَاَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ اِسْرَارًا ۝٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًا ۝١٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

ayahs.ar: يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَا࢜ءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًا ۝١١ۙ
ayahs.tr: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

ayahs.ar: وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْهٰرًا ۝١٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًا ۝١٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ اَطْوَارًا ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: While He has created you in stages?

ayahs.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۝١٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

ayahs.ar: وَّجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيْهِنَّ نُوْرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۢ͏ْبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ نَبَاتًا ۝١٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُكُمْ فِيْهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ اِخْرَاجًا ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ بِسَاطًا ۝١٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

ayahs.ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوْا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا ۝٢٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِيْ وَاتَّبَعُوْا مَنْ لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗٓ اِلَّا خَسَارًا ۝٢١ۚ
ayahs.tr: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا ۝٢٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوْثَ وَيَعُوْقَ وَنَسْرًا ۝٢٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ اَضَلُّوْا كَثِيْرًا࣢ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

ayahs.ar: مِمَّا خَطِيْ࢜ـٰٔتِهِمْ اُغْرِقُوْا فَاُدْخِلُوْا نَارًا࣢ۙ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَنْصَارًا ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَي الْاَرْضِ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ دَيَّارًا ۝٢٦
ayahs.tr: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ اِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْٓا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنًا وَّلِلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا ۝٢٨ࣖ
ayahs.tr: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
